title: Unify-Agent: Open-Book Agentic Image Synthesis
summary: An end-to-end multimodal agentic framework that solves the 'closed-book' problem in image generation by performing real-time web research. It utilizes a Think-Research-Recaption-Generate pipeline to ground visual synthesis in factual external evidence, significantly reducing hallucinations for rare or long-tail concepts.
research_notes: Introduced the FactIP benchmark for evaluating factual fidelity in multimodal models; developed in collaboration between Tencent Hunyuan and UCLA researchers.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from a static diffusion-based model into a fully autonomous agentic system in early 2026. It now features an optimized pipeline that autonomously identifies knowledge gaps in prompts and acquires real-world visual evidence via web-search grounding before synthesis.
